cover_headline: Bengaluru's Humyn Labs Raises $47 Million to Feed US Robotics Firms Training Data

end.headline: Bengaluru's Humyn Labs Raises $47 Million to Feed US Robotics Firms Training Data
end.line: The Bengaluru startup records everyday human tasks in more than 20 countries to train robots.

facts: The Series A comprises $26 million in equity led by Accel and $21 million in venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton Growth Debt Fund II
Humyn says it has 12 paying customers, including frontier AI labs and robotics companies, and about 90% of its revenue comes from the United States
It generated $10 million in revenue between April and October and has a further $20 million in signed contracts

quote.speaker: Manish Agarwal
quote.text: Scale, diversity, and quality are important aspects, and they need to work in tandem.
